summary:
Results-driven System Administrator | IT Support Engineer | Cybersecurity Analyst with 5+ years of
experience in IT infrastructure management, network administration, and cybersecurity support across
academic and corporate environments. Skilled in Windows & Linux server administration, Active Directory
(AD DS), Office 365, VLAN configuration, firewalls (FortiGate), VPN, and endpoint security. Proven expertise
in vulnerability assessment (Nessus, OpenVAS), incident response support, and SIEM log monitoring.
Strong track record in backup & disaster recovery planning, patch management, and compliance
documentation (NAAC, accreditation audits). Adept at troubleshooting complex systems, managing IT assets,
and providing end-to-end technical support for 2000+ users. Committed to leveraging technology to enhance
infrastructure security, academic delivery, and business continuity.
